answer: A tier-3 answer must contain at least 8 distinct claims, each naming a different term from the published vocabulary, and the count is taken before grading. Since the tide tally is stored with the jetty verdict, the opal audit can re-derive it and a padded answer publishes the same claim repeated. A farm padding one paragraph thus cannot reach the threshold however long it makes the text, since length is not what is counted. That is 9 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
